name: svt
description: SVT (Sveriges Television) news and sport site, svt.se. This CLI lists section, local and tag feeds, reads articles and their related teasers, looks up video clip metadata and streams, and reads Text-TV pages.

commands.name: list-section-articles
commands.summary: List the latest article teasers (headline, lead, URL) in a news section such as utrikes or inrikes.

params.name: section
params.description: News section slug under /nyheter/, e.g. utrikes, inrikes, vetenskap, kultur, ekonomi

commands.name: list-local-news
commands.summary: List the top local news teasers for an SVT region, e.g. stockholm.

params.name: region
params.description: Local region slug, e.g. stockholm, skane, vast, ost, uppsala, gavleborg, vasterbotten, norrbotten

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get one article's metadata (headline, description, publish date, authors, image) from its schema.org NewsArticle data.

params.name: category
params.description: Top-level site area, the first URL segment

params.name: section
params.description: Second URL segment: news section (utrikes, inrikes, ...) or sport (bordtennis, fotboll, ...)

params.name: slug
params.description: Article slug, the last URL segment

commands.name: get-related-trailers
commands.summary: Get the related teaser groups (more from the same section or sport) shown under an article or page.

params.name: path
params.description: Site path of the article or page, starting with /

commands.name: get-video
commands.summary: Get metadata and stream URLs (HLS/DASH, subtitles, rights, geo-block flag) for an SVT video clip by its svtId.

params.name: id
params.description: SVT video id (svtId), e.g. 8Dva4VJ, found in article and video pages

commands.source: E4 E7 E9 E10 E11 E12 E13 E19 E20 GET https://video.svt.se/video/8Dva4VJ

commands.name: get-text-tv-page
commands.summary: Read an SVT Text-TV page by number (e.g. 100 news index, 101, 377 sport results); includes plain-text content and prev/next page numbers.

notes: svt.se has no keyword search for articles. To find content, use section feeds (list-section-articles), local feeds (list-local-news) or tag feeds (list-tag-articles).
Teaser 'url' values are site-relative paths such as /nyheter/utrikes/<slug>. Split the path into category/section/slug for get-article, or pass it unchanged as 'path' to get-related-trailers.
Local articles have four path segments (/nyheter/lokalt/<region>/<slug>), so they do not fit get-article's template. Use get-related-trailers with the full path for those.
list-tag-articles: the first 10 items of a tag page come from the server-rendered page. If cursor "0" fails, start at "10" and follow the returned cursor.
Videos with rights.geoBlockedSweden=true have metadata available everywhere, but the streams only play from Swedish IPs.
In Text-TV responses, subPages[].altText is the readable text. gifAsBase64 is a large image and is left out of the default fields.

Several capabilities seen in the recording are not exposed as commands. The RootQuery and AutoFeedPaginationQuery operations behind section 'load more', weather forecasts (/vader/prognos/<place>) and the sport TV schedule (/sport/tabla, scheduleCategory/date params) were recorded with truncated persisted-query hashes, so they cannot be replayed reliably.
Also not exposed: Målservice live scores come from enetscores with encrypted payloads, and the live blog streams through Firestore listen channels.
